run_py_writer: run the python py_writer module to create a simple RL trajectory with 100 steps
create_riegeli_writer: create a RiegeliBackendWriter instance with a data directory and metadata dictionary
record_rl_step: record an RL step using StepData with a dm_env timestep and action value
close_writer: close the RiegeliBackendWriter to finalize and flush trajectory data to disk
review_main: review the main function that writes a 100-step RL trajectory using absl flags
